name: Zepar
source:
A demon by birth, assigned to be an incubus upon reaching adulthood. Now that the Timekeepers have a plethora of open positions, he's taking the chance to break out of the mold and become someone new. As a previous denizen of Hell, he's more than aware that everyone expects him to cause trouble, but his desire to prove everyone wrong about their ill assumptions seems genuine. It does not help that by way of his profession he has the knack to make innuendos out of ordinary sentences...a habit that will take a long time to break. But what will happen when he denies his hunger? Can a demon truly change?

HOBBIES:
Finding hiding places, sneaking into college courses, gardening in the human world

LIKES:
Quiet places, Books, Learning, rabbits, plants

DISLIKES:
Crowded areas, sudden loud noises, hot spaces
